title: The Message That Actually Gets Answered
author: Steve Dalton

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a single blank monochrome paper note lying flat on the cream stage, a burnt orange marker cross stroke drawn over it

beats.change_only: a monochrome mesh grid drops over the note

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a dense stack of identical blank monochrome paper notes filling the cream stage, one note popped burnt orange among them

beats.change_only: every note turns the same pale grey and the orange one vanishes

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome cutout figure at a desk sweeping a row of identical notes aside with one hand, a burnt orange arrow trailing the sweep

beats.change_only: the swept notes drop off the bottom edge of the frame

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a single monochrome paper note with a heavy burnt orange marker cross drawn corner to corner
MEDIUM: a monochrome halftone book cutout standing upright on the cream stage, a flat burnt orange disc behind it

beats.change_only: a small blank note leans against the base of the book

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a single blank paper note on the cream stage with six short horizontal burnt orange strokes stacked on it, no letters

beats.change_only: a thick block of dense grey lines beside it is struck out in orange

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the top short burnt orange stroke on the note, the rest of the strokes faded to pale monochrome

beats.change_only: a long trailing grey line beside it shrinks to a stub

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the second stroke on the note picked out in burnt orange with a hand-drawn orange circle around it

beats.change_only: a small monochrome magnifier shape settles over that stroke

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a large blank monochrome plaque cutout standing on the cream stage with a burnt orange cross stroke drawn across it

beats.change_only: the plaque shrinks and a small orange-edged note takes its place

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: one short burnt orange stroke alone on the cream stage with a soft paper drop shadow beneath it

beats.change_only: a row of identical grey copies behind it crumbles away

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the blank note on the cream stage with the third stroke drawn in burnt orange and a small orange arrow pointing to it

beats.change_only: a small monochrome hourglass appears beside the note

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome door cutout on the cream stage with a heavy burnt orange cross stroke drawn over it

beats.change_only: the door tips forward showing bare cream paper behind

beats.scene: MEDIUM: two monochrome cutout figures facing each other on the cream stage, a burnt orange stroke arcing between them

beats.change_only: the arc between them thickens and steadies

beats.scene: MEDIUM: two small blank monochrome cards side by side on the cream stage, each edged burnt orange, nothing else in frame

beats.change_only: a dense grid of grey squares behind them is struck out in orange

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: the oversized monochrome hand releasing a single blank note into the air, a burnt orange arrow rising from it
MEDIUM: a thick monochrome document block on the cream stage with a burnt orange cross stroke drawn over it

beats.change_only: the document block slides out of frame to the left

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: ten small blank monochrome notes scattered across the cream stage, only one edged burnt orange

beats.change_only: a burnt orange marker circle draws around the single orange note

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome hourglass on the cream stage with one small blank note beside it, a single burnt orange tick stroke above

beats.change_only: the note beside the hourglass shrinks to half its size

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the oversized monochrome hand lifting away from an empty cream stage, a burnt orange stroke trailing behind it
FULL-SPREAD: a wide drift of identical pale grey notes across the cream stage with one large burnt orange cross stroke over the whole drift

beats.change_only: the grey drift collapses to ten orange-edged notes in a row

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: one blank note with a single hand-drawn burnt orange mark on it, clearly different from the pale grey notes behind

beats.change_only: the grey notes behind it fade away entirely

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a single blank note standing upright at the centre of the cream stage on a flat burnt orange disc, tape strips at the corners
